invariants.summary: For a program accepted by an execution backend with a comparable observable result, that result must match the bytecode VM semantic reference.
Integer representation, arithmetic, overflow behavior, and error class must agree across enabled execution backends.
Float boxing, unboxing, arithmetic, NaN handling, and observable results must agree across enabled execution backends.
Native actor behavior dispatch uses the stable runtime-facing native entry ABI and preserves outer runtime helper state across nested dispatch.
A persistence backend that supports atomic durable transitions must commit all Nulang-owned records in one logical transition together; unsupported backends fail closed.
Durable transition commits are fenced by activation epoch and monotonic sequence so stale or reordered activations cannot advance committed state.
